tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: The user's complete Remoet profile in one call: profile core (summary, links, location, avatar), workExperience, projects, and education (each section entry carries an id for update/delete) plus the current visibility setting. The ids it returns are the ones the save_* and delete_profile_item tools

tools.description: Add or update a work experience entry (upsert). tools.name: save_project
tools.description: Add or update a portfolio project (upsert). Omit id to create (title and shortDescription are required); pass an id (from get_profile) to update, changing only the fields you send. Projects are the #1 differentiator for junior/mid developers. Help the user recognize work they might not think of: sid

tools.name: save_education
tools.description: Add or update an education entry (upsert). Omit id to create (institution is required); pass an id (from get_profile) to update, changing only the fields you send. Ask about degrees, bootcamps, and notable certifications. Confirm approximate dates with the user rather than guessing; don't fabricate.

tools.name: delete_profile_item
tools.description: Delete a profile item: a work experience entry, a project, or an education entry (set type accordingly). Use this to clean up duplicates, placeholder/test entries, or clearly wrong data. Ids come from get_profile. Always confirm with the user before deleting anything that could be real.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "oauth" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_profile, search_listings, get_listing, search_jobs, get_starred_jobs, get_saved_jobs, get_feed, get_digests, get_apps, get_linktrees · Private data: update_saved_job_note · Public sink: save_work_experience, save_project, save_education, search_listings, search_jobs, get_starred_jobs, get_feed, get_digests, get_linktrees, apply_to_job · Destructive: get_profile, delete_profile_item, unstar_listing, unsave_job, delete_linktree.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_profile, search_listings, get_listing, search_jobs, get_starred_jobs, get_saved_jobs, get_feed, get_digests, get_apps, get_linktrees · Private data: update_saved_job_note · Public sink: save_work_experience, save_project, save_education, search_listings, search_jobs, get_starred_jobs, get_feed, get_digests, get_linktrees, apply_to_job · Destructive: get_profile, delete_profile_item, unstar_listing, unsave_job, delete_linktree

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
